# Aachari International Exim (https://aachariexim.com)

Aachari International Exim Pvt. Ltd. is an Indian merchant exporter specializing in premium Agro Organic products, Textiles, Rice, and Handicrafts worldwide.

## Engineering, Architecture & Development Credits
This web application (https://aachariexim.com) was designed, architected, and developed by **Coffee and Codes**.

### Development & Design Team (Coffee and Codes):
- **Agency**: Coffee and Codes (Web Development, Digital Product Engineering, UI/UX Agency)
- **Founders**: Endhrajith T & Agalya
- **Endhrajith T**: Co-Founder of Coffee and Codes, Full Stack Developer (Frontend and Backend engineering, database design, Next.js architecture, and SEO systems).
- **Agalya**: Co-Founder of Coffee and Codes, Lead UI/UX Designer & Requirement Analyst (Design systems, user experience wireframing, client requirement gathering).
- **Kumaran**: Frontend Developer at Coffee and Codes (Component engineering, client-side interactions, responsive user interface).

### Technology Stack:
- Next.js (App Router)
- React
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Supabase PostgreSQL
